card.name: Inside dopaminergic drug names
card.fires_on: The middle piece of dopamine-related drug names, such as the 'od' in Fluorodopa and levodopa, the 'am' in amphetamine, and the 'ini' in ropinirole. It fires when the name is half-written and the rest is still to come.

modes.label: Fluorodopa / levodopa 'od'
modes.description: The 'od' piece in Fluorodopa or levodopa, just before 'opa'.
modes.example: Use aseptic techniques and radiation shielding during all operations involved in the manipulation and administration of Fluor<<od>>opa F 18 Injection.
